title: CocoFrame
tagline: CocoFrame allows you to create your own frames without code.
description:
CocoFrame allows you to create your own frames without code. We have a UI where you can configure your parameters and in a few seconds you have your frame ready to publish.

You can also explore Farcaster profiles, and see how much ETH each user collected with our frames.

We use the Pinata APIs to bring us Farcaster users and with them we build a client where you can view their entire profile. We created a Tool so that anyone can create a smart contract and a frame but without touching code. To do this, we deploy the smart contracts in Base.

We built the Frontend with Nestjs and Chakra UI, and the frames with Frog. For smart contracts we use Hardhat and Base.
